selection: 10 places deliberately selected for presence-missing contrast; some test places previously used, no holdout claims
query_design: each query asks for an activity and contains location/context; each of 30 queries searched in all three language-specific corpora
grouping: same query ranked against each 138-document language corpus, then within-query present-minus-missing, bootstrap by place
label_warning: query-specific labels manually AI-reviewed against snapshot, not independently human reviewed; MISSING means not mentioned in document only
interpretation: correlation not causal; document language, content, candidate sets, query formulation, and model language behavior are confounded; 3 queries per place not independent
